# Uninstra 3.0.0

Safety & correctness overhaul across scanning, parsing, persistence, and packaging.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Authenticode signature evidence** — `GetSigner` used a certificate-file loader on executables, so the digital-signature signal never fired; leftover scoring now extracts the embedded Authenticode cert (with per-file caching)
- **History timestamps shifted by UTC offset** — SQLite reader parsed stored UTC strings as local time, mis-dating late-evening entries by one calendar day in UTC+ locales
- **Settings never saved** — NaN window-position defaults made every settings save throw (`System.Text.Json` refuses non-finite numbers); fields are now nullable
- **Parser hardening** — unquoted uninstall commands with spaced paths (.bat/.cmd/.com/.msi/.scr) resolve fully even when the uninstaller file no longer exists; extension-less fallback splits at the last space

## 📦 Packaging

- **`Uninstra.ElevatedHelper.exe` now ships in the release zip** — previous releases omitted it, silently breaking every admin operation (HKLM cleanup, restore points, protected-path quarantine)

## ✨ Added

- Single-instance guard (named mutex per user session)
- MIT LICENSE · GitHub Actions CI (build warnings-as-errors + full test suite)
- Test coverage expanded 55 → 71 tests across 4 projects: audit-trail tests, SQLite round-trip integration tests, elevated-helper pipe protocol tests against an in-process fake server, settings-persistence regression tests, parser edge cases

## 🔧 Changed

- Package alignment: Microsoft.Extensions.* / Microsoft.Data.Sqlite → 9.0.19 (matches net9.0)
- Atomic settings saves (write-to-temp + move)
- Theme picker restricted to Dark until a light dictionary ships

## 📥 Install

Unzip and run `Uninstra.exe`. Keep `Uninstra.ElevatedHelper.exe` next to it (already arranged in the zip).

**SHA-check:** ~62 MB main executable, self-contained — no .NET runtime install needed. Windows 10+ x64.
